name: policy-twin-mobile
description: Capacitor Android/iOS native wrapper for the Jurisdiction Economic Intelligence & Policy Twin Platform. Lives entirely under mobile/ so it never conflicts with the root web build.

scripts.sync:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.run:android: npm run build:web && cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run build:web && cap run ios
scripts.build:ios: xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive
